purpose: Clip-level evaluation of the 3-day sprint (owner-approved plan 2026-11-12): every drowning clip must raise at least one alert; every normal clip must raise none. Event windows, where given, also score alert-in-window and time-to-alert.
labels: UNVERIFIED. Marked by Claude from timestamped contact sheets (20 frames per clip); the owner had no labelling time. Clip-level labels follow the owner's folders (Drowning Dataset = drowning, except IMG_5488 which shows only normal swimming: the owner's count of 31 drowning clips = 15 heldout_v1 web drownings + 14 iPhone + drowning.mp4 + drowning underwater.mp4). Windows are approximate (+-1 s) and only given where the person is large enough to judge.

rules.drowning_clip_detected: at least one alert anywhere in the clip (end-of-clip flush included)
rules.alert_in_window: an alert with t in [onset - 1.0, end + 3.0] (clips with a window only)
rules.false_alert: any alert on a normal clip; also reported per camera-hour
rules.split: by recording session: a session's clips are spread over dev and test, no clip in both; eval/heldout_v1 is unchanged and still decides on its own frozen test split
rules.sprint_rule: a change is kept when dev drowning clips detected do not fall and dev false alerts do not rise; test is run once, at the end of the sprint
